source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of network models and the OSI layers (PDF 12-14).

blocks.text: Network models batate hain ke data munazzam tareeqe se aik device se doosre tak kaise jata hai. Yeh baat-cheet ko tahon (layers) mein taqseem karte hain, aur har layer data bhejne mein khaas kaam karti hai (Fig 1.13). Tah-dar models networks ko samajhna aur sambhalna asan banate, masail dhoondne mein madad dete, aur networking mein standards ke taur par use hote hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Network models pecheeda network baat-cheet ko saada qadmon mein samajhne ke liye use hote hain.

Network layers baat-cheet ke amal ko chhote hisson mein taqseem karti hain, har aik ki khaas zimmedari hoti hai. Data qadam ba qadam layers se guzarta hai. Is se network ka design saada aur munazzam hota hai: aik layer ki tabdeeli doosri layers par asar nahi karti, aur tah-dar baat-cheet aitbaar aur control behtar karti hai.

OSI model network baat-cheet samajhne ke liye saat layers wala standard model hai. Har layer alag kaam karti hai. Yeh networks seekhne aur design karne ke liye use hota, aur mukhtalif systems ko theek tareeqe se baat karne mein madad deta hai. Bhejne wale par data application layer se physical layer tak neeche jata hai; wusool karne wale par wapas oopar jata hai.

blocks.alt: Bhejne wale (sender) ki taraf OSI model: sender computer ke saath saat tahein (layers) oopar se neeche, Application, Presentation, Session, Transport, Network, Data Link aur Physical, neeche ki taraf teeron ke saath; Physical layer se cable nikalti aur tooti lakeer receiver computer tak jati hai.

items: Physical layer: kacha (raw) data bijli, roshni ya radio signals ki shakal mein medium par bhejti; cables, connectors, voltage levels aur data ki raftar jaise hardware pehlu tay karti.
Data link layer: seedhe jure nodes ke darmiyan be-ghalti muntaqili yaqeeni banati; framing, ghalti pakarna aur durust karna, aur mushtarka medium tak rasai sambhalti.
Network layer: data ko mukhtalif networks se guzar kar source se manzil tak le jati; logical addressing (IP addresses) sambhalti aur behtareen rasta chunti.
Transport layer: devices ke darmiyan qabil-e-aitbaar, tarteeb-war delivery deti; ghalti se bahali, bahao ka control aur data ko chhote hisson (segments) mein baantna karti.
Session layer: applications ke darmiyan baat-cheet ke sessions shuru, qaim aur khatam karti; checkpoints aur rukawat ke baad bahali sambhalti.
Presentation layer: data ko application layer ke samajhne ke qabil shakal mein badalti; encryption, compression aur format ki tabdeeli karti.
Application layer: users aur applications ko seedhi services deti; HTTP, FTP aur email jaise protocols ko sahara deti.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Neechli layers data ki tabai muntaqili, darmiyani layers routing aur delivery, aur oopri layers user applications sambhalti hain. Har layer azadana kaam karti hai, aur mil kar theek baat-cheet yaqeeni banati hain.

blocks.prompt: OSI ki saat layers oopar se neeche tak batayein, aur batayein ke IP addresses aur routing kaun si layer sambhalti hai.
blocks.explanation: Application, presentation, session, transport, network, data link, physical. Network layer IP addresses aur routing sambhalti hai.

items: Tah-dar models baat-cheet ko alag kaamon wali layers mein baant'te hain.
OSI: 7 layers; sender par data neeche aur receiver par oopar.
Physical: signals; data link: frames; network: IP aur routing; transport: qabil-e-aitbaar delivery; session; presentation: format aur encryption; application: user services.
